tiers.name: Offline Transcription
tiers.description: Recordings, long audio/video files, and other asynchronous work submitted through the batch-jobs plane.

tiers.name: Realtime Transcription
tiers.description: Live captions and streaming transcription over the realtime WebSocket plane.

tiers.name: Realtime + Semantic Turn Detection
tiers.description: Mutually exclusive realtime bundle that includes realtime transcription plus semantic turn detection, aimed at conversational and voice-agent workloads.
tiers.billing_note: Semantic turn detection is not VAD and is not caption sentence splitting. It is not yet available on the public gateway.

addons.name: Recorded Context-aware Refinement
addons.description: Optional AI context correction, natural sentence breaks, semantic punctuation, and consistent proper nouns and terminology for recorded audio.
addons.billing_note: Offline/batch correction runs when the correction backend is configured (`review` defaults on). The flag is fixed for the job.

addons.name: Realtime Context-aware Refinement
addons.description: Optional AI context correction for realtime sessions.
addons.billing_note: Pro profile only. The Lite profile is included in the base transcription price. Enabled per session via `session.update.refinement` before audio; the flag is fixed for the session.

addons.name: Realtime Context-aware Translation
addons.description: Optional AI context-aware realtime text translation, priced per target language.
addons.billing_note: Per target language: each additional output language adds one translation charge. Enabled per session via `session.update.target_languages` (or `translate_to`); the target set is fixed before audio.

addons.name: Recorded Context-aware Translation
addons.description: Optional AI context-aware translation for recorded audio, priced per target language.
addons.billing_note: Per target language: each additional output language adds one translation charge. Enabled per job via `target_languages` (or `translate_to`); the target set is fixed at job creation.

lite.name: Lite
lite.description: Short prompt, two segments of context, tight character and completion budgets. Included in the base transcription price.

pro.name: Pro
pro.description: Full prompt, ten segments of context, and a rolling guide. Billed as the realtime refinement add-on.

combinations.name: Realtime + turn detection + refinement + one translation language

metering_rules: Bill by actual processed audio seconds; do not round a request up to a whole minute.
Silence that is sent and processed counts toward realtime duration. Idle time where the connection is open but no audio is processed is not billed; this still needs implementation verification.
Partial/final/caption revisions on the same stream are not charged ASR again. Resubmitting independent audio is a new task.
Turn detection is included in the upgraded realtime tier. Refinement is billed on the audio duration where enabled. Translation is billed per target language × processed duration.
Feature flags are frozen per session/job: refinement and translation targets are set before audio and apply to the whole session/job. Mid-session changes are rejected.
Failed retries, duplicate-connection dedupe, and partial-failure refunds must be tested before billing is enabled.
Subscription products, deployment integration, hosting, operations, and enterprise SLAs are quoted separately. Existing customer agreements are not changed retroactively.
Each billing record must store the rate-card version, customer agreement, audio seconds, feature flags, target-language count, and usage ID.
examples: 1,000 minutes of realtime + refinement + one translation language = 1,000 × $0.0297 = $29.70.
Quote from the exact per-minute rate. The ~$1.80/hour figure is display-only and is not a second billing rate.
notes: Base transcription tiers are mutually exclusive; choose exactly one.
Realtime refinement has two profiles: `lite` (included in the base transcription price) and `pro` (billed as the realtime refinement add-on).
Basic punctuation, ordinary segmentation, and VAD are included at no extra charge.
Semantic turn detection is not VAD and is not caption sentence splitting.
Refinement and translation can be enabled independently. Translation includes the context understanding required to produce the translation and does not require refinement.
This rate card covers the transcription API only. Lanson Live subscription plans (Free / Flow / Focus / Enterprise) meter active speech minutes and are unaffected by this card.
Stripe price IDs are intentionally absent until usage billing is enabled.
